name: misgeret
description: מסגרת — open-source, local-first financial awareness for Windows, macOS and Linux
author: Misgeret

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run desktop:typecheck
scripts.build:client: npm run build:manifest && npm run build -w client && node scripts/copy_build_manifest.mjs client/dist
scripts.build:server: npm run build:manifest && tsc -p server/tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy_build_manifest.mjs server/dist
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run desktop:build
scripts.desktop:package: npm run prepare:chromium && npm run build:desktop && npm run test:build-contract && electron-forge package && npm run audit:desktop
scripts.desktop:make: npm run prepare:chromium && npm run build:desktop && npm run test:build-contract && electron-forge make && npm run audit:desktop && npm run release:metadata
scripts.desktop:release: node scripts/verify_release_prerequisites.mjs && npm run prepare:chromium && npm run build:desktop && npm run test:build-contract && electron-forge make --arch=x64 && npm run audit:desktop && node scripts/verify_authenticode.mjs && npm run release:metadata
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run desktop:test && npm run test:scripts && npm run build:desktop && npm run test:build-contract
